implementation: Global bind/import updates the assigned root's visibility. Existing declarations remain visible after leaving a lexical scope; later declarations never resolve earlier references. Export alone does not publish a candidate.

Entity.scope holds the namespace root, while Occurrence.scope and stage preserve the lexical location. namespaceStage captures the actual namespace search history. Lexical/Open require identical stage and namespaceStage; Global requires the assigned root.
DuplicateGlobal rejects a second same-name introduction with primary and previous-definition related spans, including escaped Unicode names. Independent foreign bundles keep independent roots.

Real CBOR roundtrips preserve namespaceStage and typed errors. Structural decoding rejects missing/out-of-range stages, wrong policy combinations and incorrect root ownership; it does not grant execution provenance.
